summary: Curated the plan-generated skeleton into source-aware Open Library recipes with compact agent JSON, bounded requests, and explicit source/rate-limit caveats.
reason: Issue #1191 needs an agent-usable Open Library metadata CLI, not placeholder environment-variable commands or a raw endpoint mirror. The first print keeps the command surface read-only and aligned with Open Library's anti-bulk usage guidance.
validated_outcome: Unit tests cover book search request shape, contact-bearing User-Agent construction, author works lookup, subject slugging/details, and source-rate posture. Dogfood validation covers help/version, sources, doctor, and bounded live public API commands.
